# Reliability of the final scores

All numbers below recompute the FINAL score (P + D, locked method) on resampled or split data, holding the eligible set and the shrinkage parameters fixed.


## Batting (32 eligible players)

| check | final SCORE | P (pressure level) | U (usual level) | D (pressure minus usual) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| split-half by match, Spearman (mean of 100) | -0.10 | -0.09 | 0.15 | -0.11 |
| ...Spearman-Brown full-length estimate | -0.22 | -0.21 | 0.26 | -0.24 |
| 2025-only vs 2026-only, Spearman (n=8 with >=30 eff. pressure balls in both) | 0.33 | 0.38 | 0.52 | 0.52 |

Split-half top-10 overlap between halves: 3.5 of 10. Raw (unshrunk) pressure-minus-usual split-half Spearman: -0.13.

Bootstrap (1000 match resamples): on average 6.8 of the official top 10 stay in the top 10 (5th-95th pct: 5-8).

| rank | player | 90% rank interval | P(top 3) | P(top 10) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Ashutosh Sharma | 1-17 | 0.56 | 0.86 |
| 2 | Tim David | 1-15 | 0.39 | 0.87 |
| 3 | Namboori Tilak Varma | 1-16 | 0.36 | 0.81 |
| 4 | Marcus Stoinis | 1-20 | 0.39 | 0.80 |
| 5 | Rinku Singh | 2-20 | 0.21 | 0.73 |
| 6 | Suryakumar Yadav | 3-17 | 0.11 | 0.72 |
| 7 | Ajinkya Rahane | 3-18 | 0.10 | 0.67 |
| 8 | David Miller | 1-29 | 0.27 | 0.53 |
| 9 | Lokesh Rahul | 2-26 | 0.11 | 0.53 |
| 10 | Aniket Verma | 5-24 | 0.02 | 0.28 |
| 11 | Rajat Patidar | 2-29 | 0.12 | 0.40 |
| 12 | Shashank Singh | 4-26 | 0.03 | 0.32 |
| 13 | Romario Shepherd | 1-32 | 0.16 | 0.37 |
| 14 | Phil Salt | 6-29 | 0.02 | 0.23 |
| 15 | Shubman Gill | 8-27 | 0.00 | 0.14 |

Players with P(top 10) >= 0.5: 9. Players with P(top 10) >= 0.8: 4.


## Bowling (38 eligible players)

| check | final SCORE | P (pressure level) | U (usual level) | D (pressure minus usual) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| split-half by match, Spearman (mean of 100) | 0.07 | 0.07 | -0.01 | 0.02 |
| ...Spearman-Brown full-length estimate | 0.13 | 0.13 | -0.03 | 0.03 |
| 2025-only vs 2026-only, Spearman (n=22 with >=30 eff. pressure balls in both) | 0.57 | 0.57 | -0.01 | 0.37 |

Split-half top-10 overlap between halves: 4.1 of 10. Raw (unshrunk) pressure-minus-usual split-half Spearman: -0.14.

Bootstrap (1000 match resamples): on average 6.9 of the official top 10 stay in the top 10 (5th-95th pct: 5-8).

| rank | player | 90% rank interval | P(top 3) | P(top 10) |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| 2 | Lungi Ngidi | 1-16 | 0.46 | 0.87 |

| 7 | Mohammed Siraj | 1-25 | 0.22 | 0.67 |

## Predictive validity on held-out seasons

Correlation (Pearson) between a score computed on the training seasons and the player's actual value per pressure ball in the later test seasons. Official = P + D (univariate). This was used only to describe the method, not to choose players.

| side | train -> test | players | official P+D | P only | usual level only | all balls | bivariate P+D |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| bat | 2022-2024 -> 2025-2026 | 56 | 0.10 | 0.12 | 0.11 | 0.09 | 0.12 |
| bat | 2022-2023 -> 2024 | 29 | -0.17 | -0.16 | -0.01 | -0.05 | -0.14 |
| bat | 2023-2024 -> 2025 | 27 | -0.15 | -0.12 | 0.27 | 0.10 | -0.06 |
| bat | 2024-2025 -> 2026 | 24 | 0.07 | 0.10 | 0.14 | 0.19 | 0.12 |
| bowl | 2022-2024 -> 2025-2026 | 107 | 0.32 | 0.32 | 0.30 | 0.33 | 0.39 |
| bowl | 2022-2023 -> 2024 | 77 | 0.05 | 0.05 | 0.22 | 0.12 | 0.17 |
| bowl | 2023-2024 -> 2025 | 76 | 0.28 | 0.28 | 0.23 | 0.26 | 0.32 |
| bowl | 2024-2025 -> 2026 | 71 | 0.17 | 0.17 | 0.09 | 0.23 | 0.21 |

All correlations are low: next-season pressure performance is hard to predict for anyone. Scores that also use ordinary balls (all balls, bivariate) predict slightly better in some splits, because a player's true pressure level and usual level are highly correlated (bivariate prior correlation 0.73 batting, 1.00 bowling). The official score still uses pressure balls only for the level term, because the brief asks who delivered under pressure, not who is best overall; the bivariate variant is reported in sensitivity.csv.


## How to read this

- U (usual level) is the most repeatable part; P (pressure level) is less repeatable because only a quarter of balls are pressure balls; D (pressure minus usual) is close to pure noise at 2025-26 sample sizes, which is why the locked shrinkage gives it little room to move a player.
- Rank intervals are wide in the middle of each list: ranks are firm at the top and only roughly ordered below that.
